pyg_landlord.text: The ceiling in the smoke room is covered in signatures. Climbers have been signing it since before the war, and the Everest team of 1953 signed it too.
Come in for tea, if the weather turns. In this valley the weather turns about every nine minutes.

pyg_instructor.text: I teach people to read a map in a cloud. You are meant to be calm. They are meant to be calm too. That is the difficult bit.
Plas y Brenin is the national mountain centre. Half the people you see on the hills in Britain learned something here.

pyg_photographer.text: Everyone stands here for the photograph. The lakes, the ridge, the reflection. It is a good photograph.
The Horseshoe in the morning is a postcard. By lunchtime it is a cloud. I take my pictures early and eat my sandwiches late.
